fusions.name: Scorched Echo
fusions.desc: Screeches a tongue of flame that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then echoes to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Fevered Colony
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bats in a spread, each of which deals 3 damage with a 25% chance to set its target [Burning] for 5 seconds. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Smoke Roost
fusions.desc: Veils you in smoke for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Embers
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, an ember drops on the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 5 damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
